title: 星期天去商场
titleEnglish: Going to the Mall on Sunday
text:
今天是星期天,我很累。早上我起床很晚,吃了早饭就在家休息休息。

小明给我打电话:“你在做什么?我们一起去商场走走吧!”

我说:“好啊,但是天气不太好,下午可能下雨。”

小明说:“没关系,商场里面不会下雨。”

我们到了商场,先去书店,在书店看了看书。我想买一件红色的衣服,就问问那个女士。小明说:“你去那边看一看吧。”

下午三点,外面真的下雨了。我们坐在咖啡店里,听听歌。小明笑了笑说:“你说对了!”

questions.explanation: Xiao Ming invites the narrator to go to the mall (去商场走走), and the text says they arrived at the mall (我们到了商场).

questions.promptEnglish: What does the narrator want to buy?
questions.explanation: The passage says 我想买一件红色的衣服 (I want to buy a red piece of clothing).

questions.promptEnglish: What is the weather like at 3 p.m.?
questions.explanation: The passage says 下午三点,外面真的下雨了, so it was raining, just as the narrator predicted.

questions.sentence: 早上我起床很晚,吃了＿＿就在家休息休息。
我想买一件红色的＿＿,就问问那个女士。

translation: Today is Sunday, and I'm very tired. I got up very late this morning, and after eating breakfast I just rested at home for a while.
Xiaoming called me and said, "What are you doing? Let's go for a walk at the mall together!"
I said, "Sure, but the weather isn't very good. It might rain this afternoon."
Xiaoming said, "It doesn't matter. It won't rain inside the mall."

We got to the mall and went to the bookstore first, where we looked at some books for a while. I wanted to buy a red piece of clothing, so I asked that lady. Xiaoming said, "Why don't you go over there and take a look?"
At three o'clock in the afternoon, it really did start to rain outside. We sat in a coffee shop and listened to some songs. Xiaoming smiled and said, "You were right!"

issues.description: The passage says 'Xiao Ming said: 你去那边看一看吧' right after the narrator asks the female staff; it is unclear who is speaking, since the narrator asked the woman, so the dialogue flow is slightly unnatural (the reply would more naturally come from the woman).

Xiao Ming's closing line '你说对了!' is slightly odd because he earlier said the mall wouldn't rain; it is understandable but the logic is mildly unclear. Also, 'It is raining outside' is only inferred while sitting in a coffee shop, which is fine.

Cloze z3: the sentence 外面真的＿＿了 with answer 下雨 is fine, but the hint 'to rain' maps to 下雨 (a verb-object compound), so the blank takes two characters; learners might try just 雨, which would not fit grammatically.
